task.task_name: Implement CLI command entrypoint and exit/error contract
task.description: Implement the documented executable CLI surface and stable process contract required by six independent child-process RED scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Package bin resolves to a runnable built Node entrypoint on Node 22.13+.
init, contact export/import, relay publish, send, poll, history and doctor implement the reviewed flags and reject malformed arguments with exit 2.
Contact import requires --yes or explicit interactive yes; forged/trust/protocol rejection exits 3.
Temporary relay failures exit 4 and local encrypted persistence failures exit 5.
--json emits exactly one success/error object on stdout; stderr diagnostics/prompts and normal outputs redact secrets/plaintext except explicit history results.
Offline commands do no network I/O; runtime commands delegate to completed profile/outbound/inbound/RelayClient APIs.
All six process tests and all previous CLI/workspace tests/typechecks pass unchanged.
task.context: Follow cli.test.ts exactly. Use node:util parseArgs or an equally strict parser. Init writes reviewed config values and calls openProfile initialize without replacement. Build/bin must be reproducible for a clean checkout; if bundling, externalize only native runtime dependencies that Node can resolve and keep source maps/secrets out of output. Read config.json through parseClientConfig to construct RelayClient for network commands. Map ConfigurationError/argument issues to 2; trust/protocol/invalid relay response to 3; retryable RelayError to 4; encrypted store/profile corruption/wrong key to 5. Never serialize underlying exception messages. Do not commit.
task.module_patterns: Node ESM CLI, strict parseArgs, one JSON stdout envelope, stderr prompts, existing profile/outbound/inbound runtime APIs, process-level Vitest.

test_case_specs.run_command: cd apps/cli && pnpm exec vitest run src/commands/cli.test.ts
